method: Foot: visual inspection of source frames, followed by the corrections in label-review.json after exploratory measurements; excluded means not visibly on foot or ambiguous supporting surface. Edge is screen-relative, unknown unless visible. Vehicle: source-frame and before/after temporal context review; P is only a parked candidate, T/D are traffic/driving negatives, X is ambiguous. Section classifiers and model answers are not ground truth. This development corpus is not a blinded held-out validation set.

vehicle_label_limit: P denotes a visually stationary parked candidate based on position and before/after context. It is a provisional parked label, never a verified empty-seat label. No visible occupant is not evidence of an empty seat. Hidden occupants cannot be excluded, so positive parked-empty accuracy is not established; the three-class table scores this weaker proxy explicitly. T/D are stronger negative evidence. X is excluded, never treated as parked.
